title: Respectful travel: customs and etiquette in Kiribati
summary: A sample article on general principles of respectful travel, written without specific unverified claims.
body: This is sample content illustrating the tone and structure of a culture-and-traditions article: respectful, general, and free of stereotypes.
A finished version should be reviewed by someone knowledgeable about contemporary I-Kiribati customs — ideally a local contributor — rather than drafted from assumption.
